title: ChatItemSprite
description: paper plugin that display item to chat with sprites
body:
# ChatItemSprite

**ChatItemSprite** is a lightweight Paper plugin that displays items in Minecraft chat.

Unlike other ChatItem plugins, it displays an item sprite before the item name, and the item name is localized based on each player's client language.

*The sprite feature can be disabled in `config.yml` if desired.*

## Features

* Display item with sprites directly in chat
* Per-user language support for vanilla item names
* Supports vanilla Minecraft items
* Supports custom items from **ItemsAdder**
* Lightweight and optimized for modern Paper servers
* Designed to work seamlessly with existing chat systems

## Requirements

* Paper 26.2+
* Java 25

## Known Issues
* some blocks displaying weird sprites (condult, lightning rod, etc.)
